outcomeNote: a single inference from the mishna, followed in the next unit by the Rav Pappa bar Shmuel story

segments.he: מִי שֶׁבֵּירַךְ וְאַחַר כָּךְ נִתְמַנָּה לוֹ שׁוֹפָר — תּוֹקֵעַ וּמֵרִיעַ וְתוֹקֵעַ. טַעְמָא דְּלָא הֲוָה לֵיהּ שׁוֹפָר מֵעִיקָּרָא, הָא הֲוָה לֵיהּ שׁוֹפָר מֵעִיקָּרָא, כִּי שָׁמַע לְהוּ — אַסֵּדֶר בְּרָכוֹת שָׁמַע לְהוּ.
segments.en: § The mishna taught: In the case of «one who recited the blessings» of the additional prayer «and» only «afterward a shofar became available to him, he sounds» a tekia, «sounds» a terua «and sounds» a tekia; this is a set that he repeats three times. The Gemara explains: «The reason» that he may do this is «that he did not have a shofar at the outset.» This indicates that if «he had a shofar at the outset, when he hears» the blasts «he must hear them by the order of the blessings,» i.e., one set must be sounded after each special blessing.

moves.cueHe: טעמא דלא הוה ליה שופר מעיקרא

moves.about: since the reason is that he had no shofar at first, one who had a shofar must hear the blasts in the order of the blessings
